figures.caption: Left: measured $C_T$ per grid vs the three $(1+k)C_F$ predictions. Right: the closure residual per grid for calibers A/B/C; every bar is far outside the ±3% gate.

Left: Prohaska regression $C_T/C_F$ on $Fr^4$ over the five transcribed AFF-8 ladder points, with the recorded $(1+k)$ for comparison. Right: the per-point $k=C_T/C_F-1$ along the ladder, showing why the fit is weakly constrained ($R^2$ well below 1).

AN-ITTC57 as a function of Re with the case point (Re=1e3), the AFF-8 anchor point (Re≈1.17e7) and the laminar case reference. The ITTC-57 line is a turbulent correlation: it has a pole at Re=1e2 and lies ~79% above the laminar reference at the case Reynolds number, which is the structural reason the closure cannot hold.

Left: number of scalar leaves transcribed per source artifact. Right: readback mismatches per source — zero everywhere, i.e. every transcribed value resolves back to its source with identical type and value.
